name: Tryptophan Biosynthesis Pathway
description: Tryptophan biosynthesis in E. coli proceeds through 5 enzymes (encoded by trpEDCBA genes) converting chorismate to tryptophan via 5 steps. The pathway includes anthranilate synthase (TrpE/TrpD), anthranilate phosphoribosyltransferase (TrpD), indole-3-glycerol phosphate synthase (TrpC), and tryptophan synthase (TrpA/TrpB). The tryptophan synthase α/β complex channels indole between active sites. The pathway is regulated by feedback inhibition (Trp inhibits TrpE) and transcriptional attenuation. This is a model for metabolic channeling and coupled reactions.
scientificAccuracy: Based on crystallographic and biochemical studies of E. coli Trp biosynthesis.
